integrity: Finite numerical reproduction supplements, but does not establish, the unrestricted proof; uses the preexisting prime-cyclic uncertainty theorem for strict spectral endpoints.
scientific_limitations: The exact sharp norm is expressed by a finite restricted Jacobi-sum maximum; no closed radical expression at arbitrary primes is asserted. The safe-prime gap is qualitative. Higher prime powers and primes congruent to 1 mod 4 are not covered. Specialist historical priority comparison remains warranted.
title: Paley half-band concentration: exact character spectrum and complementary spectral pairs
